trap.label: inversão sem auxiliar
trap.wrong: Rarely dared the numbers to rise.
trap.right: Rarely did the numbers dare to rise.
trap.why: Em português podemos inverter verbo e sujeito livremente. Em inglês, com verbo comum usa-se do/does/did antes do sujeito.

mcq.q: Rarely ___ the numbers dare to rise.
Which has the SAME meaning as “They had never seen it”?

fix.wrong: Rarely they had seen such growth.
fix.right: Rarely had they seen such growth.

fix.wrong: Rarely did the numbers dared to rise.
fix.right: Rarely did the numbers dare to rise.

rewrite.prompt: Comece com Rarely: “The numbers rarely dared to rise.”
rewrite.answer: Rarely did the numbers dare to rise.
